DIAGNOSIS READY: Intraventricular Hemorrhage (Grade II or III) secondary to sepsis in a premature infant.

The combination of prematurity, history of chorioamnionitis, sepsis markers (elevated CRP), and confirmed ventricular hemorrhage on ultrasound explains the seizures and lethargy. We must confirm the specific grade of hemorrhage and check for hydrocephalus, as this dictates the immediate need for neurosurgical consultation and management of intracranial pressure.
